meta.name: discord-list-channels
meta.description: List all channels in a Discord guild/server via the Discord API. Use this skill when the user wants to see all channels, find specific channels, or audit server structure.

copy.tagline: 列出 Discord 服务器中的所有频道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要通过 API 查看 Discord 服务器的频道结构。
copy.tagline_en: List all channels in a Discord server
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to view or audit Discord server channels via API.

howto.what: Claude可以通过Discord API列出指定服务器的所有频道（包括文字、语音、分类、公告、舞台等），并支持按类型、名称、分类过滤、排序，输出为简单列表、详细列表、层级列表或CSV格式。
howto.when: 当用户要求查看Discord服务器的所有频道、查找特定频道、审查服务器结构时触发。

say.text: 列出我的Discord服务器的所有频道。

say.note: 过滤出类型为语音的频道。

say.text: 帮我找到名为「公告」的频道ID。

howto.what_en: Claude can list all channels in a given Discord server (including text, voice, category, announcement, stage, etc.) via the Discord API, support filtering by type, name, or category, and output as simple list, detailed list, hierarchical list, or CSV.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants to see all channels in a Discord server, find specific channels, or audit server structure.

say_en.text: List all channels in my Discord server.

say_en.note: Searches by name and shows ID.
